title: Nano High-Tech Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Nano High-Tech Co., Ltd. is a Chinese aerogel manufacturer founded in 2004. The company describes itself as a national high-tech enterprise integrating research, production, and sales of silica aerogel materials and aerogel composite products for industrial insulation, energy, and battery safety applications.

Company Overview

The company serves domestic and export markets with a product portfolio that spans silica aerogel insulation materials, custom thermal-protection products, and specialty composites. Its public English-language site highlights long-running aerogel R&D and commercialization activity in Zhejiang Province.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: Mainland China and export-oriented international markets.
  • Focus Areas: Silica aerogel materials, industrial thermal insulation, battery thermal protection, and specialty aerogel composite development.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Customized battery thermal-protection products
  • Removable insulation covers
  • Aerogel fabric
  • Powders and coatings
  • Aerogel pipe shells
  • Public Capacity: Not clearly disclosed on the English pages reviewed.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Site: Zhejiang Province, China.
  • International Certifications: Not clearly disclosed on the English pages reviewed.
  • Official Website: https://en.nanuo.cn/
